app.title: Study Method — Tutor

home.title: Learn programming and math with AI-generated lessons
home.description: Type a subject — such as "Invert a binary tree" or "Quadratic equations" — and get a lesson with explanation, analogy, visualization and hands-on challenges validated by tests.

configureKeys.title: Set up your AI keys
configureKeys.description: Add and validate your DeepSeek and Brave Search keys in Settings.

subject.title: Type a subject
subject.description: For example: "Invert a binary tree" or "Quadratic equations".

learn.title: Learn and practice with challenges
learn.description: Read the lesson, follow the visualizations and solve test-validated challenges.

setup.readyDescription: Your DeepSeek and Brave Search keys are configured. Pick a subject and start.
setup.missingDescription: Configure the DeepSeek and Brave Search keys so the app can generate lessons and search sources.

trail.title: Where you left off
trail.empty: Nothing in progress — pick a subject below

confirm.skipMessage: Skip the tutorial? You can reopen it later from the help button.
confirm.closeMessage: Close the tutorial? You can reopen it later from the help button.

shellAppTitle.title: Study Method
shellAppTitle.description: This is the coding tutor. Generate AI-powered lessons and solve hands-on challenges in the tabs below.

shellThemeToggle.title: Light/dark theme
shellThemeToggle.description: Switch between light, dark or system theme using the theme button in the top bar.

shellLanguageSwitcher.title: Language
shellLanguageSwitcher.description: Switch the interface language between Portuguese and English here. Your choice is saved automatically.

shellNavTabs.title: Navigation
shellNavTabs.description: Use the tabs to navigate: Settings (configuration), Lesson (lesson generation) and Challenge (practice).

settingsKeys.title: API keys
settingsKeys.description: In Settings you set up and validate the DeepSeek (lesson generation) and Brave Search (sources) keys, and manage the local model.

lessonSubject.title: Generate a lesson
lessonSubject.description: Type the subject you want to learn about and click "Generate lesson" to research sources and build the material.

challengeEditor.title: Code editor
challengeEditor.description: Open a challenge and write your solution in this editor (CodeMirror), without autocomplete — practice coding from memory.

challengeTerminal.title: Test output
challengeTerminal.description: The deterministic test results appear in this terminal, with a pass verdict or failure details.

challengeTestAnswer.title: Test answer
challengeTestAnswer.description: Click "Test answer" to run the tests and get feedback from the grader on your solution.

tourComplete.title: You know the basics!
tourComplete.description: Browse the tabs to explore. You can reopen this tutorial anytime from the help button.

settingsKeysFill.description: Fill in your DeepSeek and Brave Search keys in this section. They power lesson generation and source search.

openSettings.title: Go to Settings
openSettings.description: Click the Settings tab to set up your API keys.

openLesson.title: Go to Lesson
openLesson.description: Click the Lesson tab to generate your first study material.

lessonSubjectFill.description: Type the subject you want to study into this field.

lessonGenerate.title: Generate the lesson
lessonGenerate.description: Click "Generate lesson" to research sources and build the material.

openChallenge.title: Go to Challenge
openChallenge.description: Click the Challenge tab to practice with an exercise.

challengeEditorType.description: Write your solution in this code editor (no autocomplete).

quickStartComplete.title: Done!
quickStartComplete.description: You now know the essentials. You can restart the tutorial anytime from the help button.

qsOpenLesson.description: Navigate to the Lesson tab to generate a study material.

qsOpenChallenge.description: Navigate to the Challenge tab to practice challenges.

qsChallengeTestAnswer.description: When you solve a challenge, click "Test answer" to validate.

selection.title: Want a tour?
selection.subtitle: A short tutorial introduces the interface and shows how to generate lessons and solve challenges.
selection.quickTourDescription: See the top bar, the tabs, and learn to generate a lesson and test a solution.
selection.quickStartDescription: A quick look at the tabs, with no key setup required. Great to get going now.
selection.fullTutorialDescription: Step-by-step guide across all tabs: set up keys, generate a lesson and test a solution.

helpHint.title: Type any doubt
helpHint.description: This is the lesson subject field. Type the topic you want to study and generate an AI-powered lesson.
